title: Felix and the Summer
author: Cyrus Okonkwo
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
